title: Sr. Business System Analyst - SAP EWM

full_description: Company Description It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here. Job Description Primary Function of Position The Sr Business Analyst for SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) will possess both the technical and functional understanding of the business processes and will be a key person implementing business processes software solutions and systems implementation. He will partner closely with our business stakeholders and project teams in the US to deliver multiple EWM warehouse management deployments. He will support implementations on SAP S/4HANA with Embedded EWM and Decentralized EWM , including integration touchpoints with SAP TMS for transportation planning/execution. The role will be of a systems solution expert for identifying, analyzing, refining, translating, and finally documenting business requirements from ISI business teams. Essential Job Duties Analyze business processes, perform fit-gap analysis as required, and provide ISI business teams with cost efficient proposal on inefficiencies and risks to determine appropriate process and system design. Create functional specifications and work with cross-functional teams and development teams to deliver the technical objects. Review and contribute to design document, configuration documents and functional specifications. Conduct unit and Integration testing and regression testing. Support ISI’s production processes and all associated business systems functions. Work with ISI IT and business teams to optimize and streamline business processes and technical solutions. Identify gaps between current and future state of business processes and helps in prioritizing opportunities to improving processes through the usage of Business capability matrix (BCM) Participate in business user meetings to gather process information for sound system solutions. Collaborate and provide inputs to the development team during development phase to meet the business needs. Help business teams on reporting requirements on the reporting team working in conjunction with the data warehouse team. Conduct QA validations and participate on User Acceptance Testing (UAT) tests. Support, assist and train the users on new modified system configurations highlighting the impact on business processes. Maintain IT Business system integrity and application notes, system upgrades, changes, and user updates. Work closely with onsite team, offshore team, managers, and executives to ensure the release of high-quality solutions. Follow the Intuitive change management process. Analyze impact of changes to the corporate application landscape. title: Principal Security Engineer, Cloud Security
skills: Python, Java, JavaScript, Microservices, AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Leadership
degree_required: Any Bachelor's Degree / Any Master's Degree
full_description: Overview: Working at Atlassian Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, as part of being a distributed-first company. About Team The Product Security team at Atlassian is committed to ensuring the delivery of secure products. These teams are geographically distributed, with a presence in the USA, Australia, and India. Each team is structured uniformly to provide comprehensive product security services tailored to their respective time zones. These services include security consulting, risk identification, and mitigation consulting for all products within their purview. Recognising the critical importance of product security as a customer necessity and a competitive edge, our team holds a pivotal position within the organisation. With Atlassian's strong engineering focus and emphasis on autonomous teams, maturing the security of this complex environment stands as our core duty. Our tasks encompass identifying potential security threats in our products, devising suitable mitigation strategies, and evaluating their effectiveness on a large scale. It is imperative to execute these responsibilities in a scalable manner, allowing us to adapt to the evolving landscape shaped by changes in our business, global dynamics, adversarial strategies, customer requirements, technological advancements, and other factors. Overview As a Principal Security Engineer, Cloud Security at Atlassian, you will be the technical architect and engineer driving the architecture and technical vision across our cloud platforms, infrastructure, and software supply chain. You will partner closely with engineering leadership, platform teams, and principal architects to define secure-by-default standards, architect scalable guardrails, and lead cross - organisational initiatives that protect Atlassian’s cloud environments at global scale. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical leadership and strategic influence - diving hands-on into complex architectural designs, critical codebases, and high-severity escalations, while steering long-term security roadmaps and mentoring senior engineers across the organization. You will systematically identify systemic risks, design resilient mitigations, and ensure our cloud platforms deliver world-class security, reliability, and trust for over 300,000+ customers. Responsibilities: As a Principal Product Security Engineer, Cloud Security, you will be the technical architect and engineer driving the architecture and and strategic SME driving cloud security architecture, automation, and secure-by-default platforms across Atlassian's global footprint. You will define the technical vision, establish architectural standards, and lead cross-organizational initiatives that equip engineering teams with state-of-the-art tools, patterns, and guardrails to build secure products by default. Partnering closely with security leadership, principal architects, and platform engineering teams, you will champion strategic programs that uplift and scale our security posture across multi-cloud environments. Some of your key responsibilities will include: Strategic Architecture & Secure Design: Define and steer the overarching security architecture for multi-cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), setting company-wide secure-by-default standards, architectural patterns, and guardrails for cloud-native services and core platforms. Complex Threat Modeling & High-Impact Assessments: Drive advanced threat modeling and deep-dive security assessments across critical, complex systems, distributed microservices, and high-assurance environments (such as Isolated, Private, and Regulated/FedRAMP offerings). Platform Automation & Guardrails at Scale: Architect, champion, and scale automated security controls, detection capabilities, and self-healing guardrails embedded directly into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (IaC), systematically eliminating classes of vulnerabilities. Continuous Posture Optimization & CSPM Strategy: Set the technical direction for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and posture analytics, driving continuous compliance, maturing security baselines, and providing leadership visibility into systemic risk. Operational & Architectural Excellence: Establish company-wide reusable security frameworks, engineering guidelines, and operational standards that improve resilience, reliability, and security performance across Atlassian products. Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a technical sponsor and mentor for security and software engineers across the organization, fostering an inclusive culture of engineering excellence, security advocacy, and cross-team capability uplift. Critical Incident Advisory & Architectural Remediation: Act as the principal cloud security authority during high-severity security incidents, partnering with Incident Response to conduct root-cause investigations, formulate long-term architectural mitigations, and prevent recurrence. Executive & Stakeholder Influence: Translate complex cloud security risks and technical roadmaps into strategic priorities for executive and non-technical stakeholders, driving consensus and cross-functional alignment on mission-critical security initiatives. On Your First Day, We'll Expect You To Have 10+ years of experience in security engineering with deep specialization in cloud security, secure architecture, and platform security at enterprise or hyper-growth SaaS scale. Proven track record as a technical authority or principal engineer driving large-scale security architectures, risk mitigations, and threat modeling initiatives across complex SaaS and cloud-native systems. Deep, hands-on expertise in multi-cloud security (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure) and container orchestration ecosystems (Docker, Kubernetes, service mesh). Extensive experience designing, securing, and conducting comprehensive architectural reviews for highly regulated, high-assurance cloud environments (such as Isolated, Private, Government, and FedRAMP offerings). Demonstrated experience guiding broad architectural transformations, including overseeing security strategy for monolith-to-microservices migrations. Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language (such as Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript) and proven experience authoring scalable security automation, tooling, and infrastructure as code (IaC). Deep experience embedding automated security controls, policy-as-code, and compliance gates into modern CI/CD pipelines. Exceptional technical communication and executive influence, with a demonstrated ability to align diverse engineering teams, architects, and senior leadership around strategic security goals. Proven track record of mentoring and coaching senior engineers and cultivating an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture. Compensation: At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. Qualifications: Required: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Deep architectural mastery of cloud security, zero trust architecture, tenant data isolation, cryptographic systems/encryption, and multi-tenant SaaS environments at enterprise scale. Proven track record designing and driving infrastructure as code (IaC) governance, centralised secrets management, and embedding automated security guardrails across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC). Deep understanding of cloud detection engineering, distributed telemetry/logging, IAM graph analysis, least-privilege policy automation, and enterprise alert optimisation. Demonstrated ability to champion developer velocity and engineering experience (DevEx) while establishing robust, non-negotiable security guardrails. Exceptional communication, technical leadership, and stakeholder influence across both executive leadership and engineering teams. It's great, but not required if you have: Extensive experience architecting and building scalable internal software platforms or developer tooling that automate security and compliance workflows. Discovered and disclosed notable CVEs, or active maintainership/contributions to open-source security tooling and frameworks. Delivered presentations at recognized industry security conferences (e.g., Black Hat, DEF CON) or published security research. Deep hands-on experience securing modern serverless architectures, service meshes, and large-scale container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes). Experience architecting security controls for highly regulated cloud environments (such as FedRAMP, Isolated, or Sovereign Cloud offerings). You’ll Thrive Here If You Take ownership of outcomes and drive projects to completion. Are proactive in identifying and mitigating security risks. Enjoy collaborating across teams and mentoring others. Communicate clearly and adapt your message to your audience. Are passionate about scaling security through automation and best practices. Benefits & Perks Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits. About Atlassian At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.
